frozen_reason: the three blank annotator templates were generated from this draw and distributed before any labelling started; the draw is therefore a frozen study artefact, not a regenerable output
selection: proportional largest-remainder stratified draw over (severity band, evidence band, root-cause label status); stratum members sorted, seeded shuffle, ties broken lexicographically
redraw_policy: annotation/iaa_v1/sample.jsonl is frozen and is never regenerated in place. A new draw requires --redraw --out annotation/iaa_v<N> --draw-version iaa-draw-<N>.0 --seed <explicit> --rationale <text>; it creates a separately versioned sample and its own frozen manifest while leaving v1 untouched.
